endorsements.name: Ali Firas
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-13437
endorsements.description: When zx is invoked with --prefer-local=<path>, the CLI creates a symlink named ./node_modules pointing to <path>/node_modules. Due to a logic error in src/cli.ts (linkNodeModules / cleanup), the function returns the target path instead of the alias (symlink path). The later cleanup routine removes what it received, which deletes the target directory itself. Result: zx can delete an external <path>/node_modules outside the current working directory.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.6)
